status: Discovery candidates only; individual paper metadata verification delegated to parent.
excluded_discovery_items: Generic LLM/model reports, static QA/code-only benchmarks without agent interaction, ART-V generic text-to-video, standalone product blogs (Genie 2/Oasis), README code and dataset links were excluded.
potential_alias_duplicates: OpenReview/venue and arXiv versions may still be aliases; parent metadata stage should deduplicate by normalized title.
selection_rule: Initial script selects reference-number ranges by manually reviewed environment-relevant titles and excludes generic model reports, static QA/code-only work, unrelated medical world models, and pure generic text-to-video. It extracts only arXiv/DOI/recognized scholarly venues. Final candidate file additionally contains 10 individually searched/opened core papers and excludes one conference/arXiv alias; initial script alone recreates the 252-item initial list, not final supplement.
